create_metric_logger: create a MetricLogger instance to track and log training metrics with optional output file
update_metric_logger: update the MetricLogger with keyword arguments for loss, accuracy, or other scalar metrics
log_training_progress: log training progress by wrapping an iterable with MetricLogger.log_every for periodic status output
track_smoothed_metrics: track smoothed metric values using SmoothedValue with configurable window size and format string
synchronize_distributed_metrics: synchronize metric values across distributed processes using MetricLogger.synchronize_between_processes
